[[Sullivan Athletic Center|McGrath–Phillips Arena]] |champion= |bowl= |bowl_result= }} {{2016–17 Big East men's basketball standings}} The '''2016–17 DePaul Blue Demons men's basketball team''' represented [[DePaul University]] during the [[2016–17 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. They played almost all of their home games at [[Allstate Arena]] in the [[Chicago]] suburb of [[Rosemont, Illinois]], though they scheduled two regular-season games at the considerably smaller [[Sullivan Athletic Center|McGrath–Phillips Arena]], the regular home of the [[DePaul Blue Demons women's basketball|DePaul women's team]], on the school's Chicago campus. The Blue Demons, members of the [[Big East Conference]], were led by head coach [[Dave Leitao]], in the second year of his current tenure and fifth overall at DePaul. They finished the season 9–23, 2–16 in [[2016–17 Big East Conference men's basketball season|Big East play]] to finish in last place. They lost in the first round of the [[2017 Big East men's basketball tournament|Big East tournament]] to [[2016–17 Xavier Musketeers men's basketball team|Xavier]]. The season marked the Blue Demons' final season at Allstate Arena. DePaul moved both its men's and women's teams into the new [[Wintrust Arena]] on Chicago's [[Near South Side, Chicago|Near South Side]].{{cite web|url=http://www.chicagobusiness.com/article/20161116/BLOGS04/161119910/depaul-strikes-arena-naming-rights-deal-with-wintrust|title=DePaul strikes arena naming rights deal with Wintrust|accessdate=November 17, 2016|date=November 16, 2016|work=[[Crain's Chicago Business]] |first=Danny |last=Ecker}} The Blue Demons opened the arena with a game against Notre Dame on November 11, 2017.{{Cite news|url=http://www.chicagotribune.com/sports/college/ct-depaul-arena-notre-dame-spt-0518-20170517-story.html|title=DePaul to open new downtown arena against longtime rival Notre Dame|last=Pope|first=LaMond|work=chicagotribune.com|access-date=2017-05-22|language=en-US}} == Previous season == The [[2015–16 DePaul Blue Demons men's basketball team|Blue Demons]] finished the [[2015–16 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2015–16 season]] 9–22, 3–15 in Big East play to finish in ninth place.
